title: AMA and DiMe launch framework outlining physician duties in AI era
description: The AMA and Digital Medicine Society released a framework Aug. 20 defining five core physician responsibilities as AI takes on more clinical tasks. The guidance asserts human oversight remains essential, even as a JAMA viewpoint argues AI alone could outperform physicians by 2030.

title: NetDocuments launches AI tabular review for M&A due diligence
description: NetDocuments launched Tabular Review, an AI tool that converts M&A due-diligence documents into structured tables with citations. The release includes Legal Authorities, which maps case citations firm-wide and links them to CourtListener.

title: Can India scale up its AI and chip vision?
description: India AI: India has a strategic opening in AI and semiconductors as capital shifts from China, but scaling requires deeper funding, stronger IP protection, reliable infrastructure and competitive chip manufacturing to build a resilient tech ecosystem.

title: AI in risk management: Practical applications and considerations
description: Risk data is expanding faster than teams can manually structure, score, and act on it. As organizations scale, traditional risk management processes built around scattered artifacts become difficult to sustain.
